item.summary: perf(sessions): defer transcript index rebuilds to the reconcile worker (#129182) * perf(sessions): defer transcript index rebuilds to the reconcile worker Transcript replace, exact rewrite, text repair, and message-cut no longer rebuild the full FTS/active-event projection inside their synchronous write transactions. They mark the projection dirty and schedule the existing chunked worker-owned reconcile after commit via the post-commit publication seam; search already hides needs_rebuild sessions and mirror-facts falls back to raw rows while the projection lags. Doctor import and canonical repair keep synchronous reconciliation. A/B probe: compaction replace of a 60k-event transcript blocked the event loop 3197ms before, 764ms after, with the projection converging off-thread. * test(sessions): await projection convergence before proving turn cursors Replace now defers the projection rebuild, so the ordered-turn setup must wait for the reconcile worker before committed cursors are provable; the invalidation fallback for unproven cursors keeps its own coverage. * perf(sessions): size-gate synchronous transcript index rebuilds Small transcripts (<=4k events and <=4MiB) keep the origi
